headline: Innovation you can install,

brands_title: Three brands, built for the job in front of you
brands_text: Pick the brand that matches the fixture, the site and the budget. Everything ships from the same company with the same support.
lbi_title: One linkable bar. Eight ways to light the job.
lbi_text: LBI bars in 2, 3 and 4 ft with the driver inside. Link up to 40 from one feed, then set wattage and color on site. Compare all eight and try each one live in the LBI Family Overview.
finder_text: Start from the fixture on the ceiling or the pole in the lot. Each card opens the part numbers that fit.
resources_text: Specifiers, distributors, contractors and facilities teams find what they need in the same place.
